findings.summary: The argument that 'the list was in the brief and still failed' is unproven, but the doc comment, CHANGELOG and D183 would state it as fact
findings.evidence: check_design_existing_code returns Ok unless class_of_work == "design" (surveys.rs:1410-1415). The plan's own Risks section says the class of each of the 13 jobs is held in records/, which the snapshot does not have, and that at least two introspections describe 'design and measurement' or 'regression' jobs. So 'dated after 2026-11-01' does not show that those producers received an `Existing code:` assumption. Decision 1 still says 'the failure recurred while the list was in the brief'. Fix: In the doc comment, CHANGELOG and D183, say '9 of the 13 recorded jobs are dated after the check (their class of work was not measured)' rather than claiming the list was in their briefs. Keep the instruction-and-search argument, which does not depend on that claim.
findings.location: Plan Decision 1 and step 2 (doc comment text); CHANGELOG and D183 wording

findings.summary: The copied `Existing code:` filter and its drift test add a non-deliverable edit to reading.rs for little gain
findings.evidence: If the filter drifted, the only effect would be that one quoted line differs in a section that is guidance only. All assumptions are already printed in full by reading_sections (briefs.rs:315-319). Fix: Optional: drop the drift test and keep the 3-line filter with a doc comment pointing to surveys.rs:1329. Or keep the test as planned; both work.

summary: The plan matches the request and the accepted reading. The request says the producer lacks information, so the plan gives it information and adds no refusal rule. It adds a section to the producer brief that is written only for design readings and gated on a new `AcceptedReading.class_of_work` field, plus a design-only planner rule. I checked the code it relies on: `AcceptedReading` (briefs.rs:74) and its `new` constructor, `reading_sections` (briefs.rs:309), `producer_brief_with_evidence` (briefs.rs:681), `existing_tests_section`, `check_design_existing_code` and `existing_code_assumptions` in surveys.rs:1329/1409, `FIELD_MEANING_RULE` in planner.rs, and commit 671bbb9 at HISTORY.txt:1340. All exist as the plan describes. A grep for `AcceptedReading {` finds exactly the three literals the plan names outside briefs.rs. briefs.rs:4777 builds the struct through `new`, not a literal. `producer_brief_with_evidence` is the only place a producer brief is built (run/mod.rs:1177), so every design job is covered. No existing test builds a producer brief for a design reading and compares the whole text, so the new section breaks no fixture. The tests reach the real code with no test doubles: they cut the brief text at the new heading, so they fail on the base commit, and criterion 4 compares the design brief with the section removed against the code brief. My remaining findings are minor: the plan states as fact that the 9 later cases had the list in their brief, which no record shows, and the copied filter plus its drift test adds scope for little value. Athena's three scope findings are not repeated here.
